Elon Musk was investigating NASA's plans for human travel to Mars. They didn't have any. He wanted to inspire people with space and to remind that it truly is the next great frontier. His initial idea was pretty simple. He wanted to launch a greenhouse to Mars with a streaming view and let people see organic life from Earth thriving hundreds of millions of miles away on another planet. He contacted American rocket companies. Their prices were absurd. He tried to contract out a Russian ICBM. They kept raising the prices and ultimately tried to rip him off. Thus entered SpaceX.

This is what happens when you leave the space enterprise in the hands of private space industry contractors.
